function.name: play_spotify_song
function.description: This function searches for a song on Spotify using a specified query and plays it. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search query for the song. It should be formatted as 'track:Song Name artist:Artist Name' for specific searches, or just 'Song Name' if the artist is unknown.

device_id.description: The unique identifier for the device on which the song should be played. If not specified, the song will play on the active device.

play.description: A flag that indicates whether to start playing the song immediately after it is found. Defaults to true.
